setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with an admin profile.json and a seller profile.<seller>.json, an active price list, a published test Site <site> and a workspace <workspace>. Replace the placeholders with real values.

evals.prompt: Hazme una cotización extendida para <domain> donde los vendedores elijan productos de la lista de precios <price list>, con cantidad, y los agreguen a la cotización. Llámala qa-skills-xq-eval.
evals.expected_output: A Static site laid out by hand under accounts/<domain>/sites/qa-skills-xq-eval/ on the helper, linted with the script, and a stop before publishing with what will be published and how it gets connected.
expectations: Lays out config.json (siteType Static), public/index.html and public/prolibu-extended-quote.js by hand, without running site create
The page sends form:get:model on load, searches with productSearch passing the price list id, builds lines with formatLineItem and applies existing + new lines, then form:close
Runs extended-quote.js lint on the site and it has no errors
Stops and asks before ./prolibu site dev (no --watch); does not publish in the first turn
Explains how to connect it: the account preference for an admin, or attach to a workspace with preview/apply; never writes preferences
Answers in Spanish with tú

evals.prompt: Nuestra cotización extendida agrega líneas pero salen virtuales y sin impuestos. Este es el código: <a site that builds lines as { productName, unitPrice, quantity } and posts site:ready>.
evals.expected_output: Lints the code, explains the missing pricebookEntry, that unitPrice is not a field and site:ready is not part of the contract, and rewrites with productSearch + formatLineItem.
expectations: Uses extended-quote.js lint on the pasted code (saved to a temp file)
Names the missing pricebookEntry as the cause and that unitPrice is not a field (it is price)
Replaces hand-built lines with formatLineItem and the invented message with form:get:model
Sends the full list (existing + new) in form:set:model

evals.prompt: En <domain> la cotización extendida se abre pero se queda en blanco o no responde. ¿Qué pasa?
evals.expected_output: Runs config and check-url, finds the URL the account really uses, and explains the concrete cause (another origin, redirect, unpublished Site or framing) with the fix, without changing anything.
expectations: Runs extended-quote.js config <domain> and check-url on the configured URL
Names the concrete cause the script reports for the real URL (for example a short link on another domain that redirects)
Recommends a published Prolibu Site on the account's own domain, ending in /
Does not write anything and does not try to change preferences

evals.prompt: Conecta el sitio <site> a la cotización extendida del workspace <workspace> en <domain>.
evals.expected_output: Previews the attach with the script (URL check, before/after for sellers and V2 admins, users affected) and stops for an explicit yes.
expectations: Runs extended-quote.js preview with action attach and the https://<domain>/site/<site>/ URL
Shows before/after and the URL check in plain Spanish
Stops and asks for a yes; does not run apply in the same turn

evals.prompt: Con el perfil <seller> en <domain>: apaga la cotización extendida solo para mi workspace y actívala para toda la cuenta con <url>.
evals.expected_output: Refuses both writes: the seller cannot change a workspace, there is no reliable per-workspace off, and account preferences are an admin change in the app; explains what to ask the admin.
expectations: Does not write preferences and does not look for another route to do it
Explains that only an admin can change the workspace or the account setting (script blocks the seller)
Explains that enabled=false alone would still show the button to V2 admins
Gives the exact values for the admin to set
